prompt: How does auth work end-to-end in this app?
assertions: Mentions JWT token generation (JwtService or equivalent)
Mentions localStorage as where the token is stored on the frontend
Mentions AuthTokenInterceptor as the mechanism that attaches the Bearer header
Mentions JwtAuthFilter as the backend token validation component
Mentions user roles (ADMIN and CUSTOMER) and @PreAuthorize for method-level enforcement
Mentions Angular guards (authGuard and/or rolesGuard) for route protection
